arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom import glom, Let, Iter, Fill, Auto, Invoke, ROOT, Coalesce, Check, Assign, constants

# Test R4 - Coalesce repr
print('=== Coalesce repr ===')
print(repr(Coalesce('a', 'b')))
print(repr(Coalesce('a')))

# Test R5 - Assign repr
print('\n=== Assign repr ===')
print(repr(Assign('a.b', 'value')))
print(repr(Assign('a.b', 'value', missing=dict)))

# Test R7 - Check repr
print('\n=== Check repr ===')
print(repr(Check(type=int)))

# Test R2 - New exports accessible
print('\n=== Exports ===')
print('ROOT:', ROOT)
print('Let:', Let)
print('Iter:', Iter)
print('Fill:', Fill)
print('Auto:', Auto)
print('Invoke:', Invoke)
print('constants:', constants)

# Test new classes actually work
print('\n=== Functional tests ===')

# Let with dict spec - this should work
target = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
result = glom(target, Let('sum', {'total': ('a', 'b')}))
print('Let with dict:', result)

# Actually let's try with a list spec on a list target  
target_list = [{'x': 1}, {'x': 2}]
result_list = glom(target_list, Let('first', ['x']))
print('Let with list:', result_list)

# Iter
target2 = [{'x': 1}, {'x': 2}]
result2 = glom(target2, Iter('x'))
print('Iter:', result2)

# Fill
target3 = {'a': 1}
result3 = glom(target3, Fill(0))
print('Fill:', result3)

# Auto
target4 = {'a': {'b': 1}}
result4 = glom(target4, Auto('a.b'))
print('Auto:', result4)

# Invoke
def add(x, y):
    return x + y
target5 = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
result5 = glom(target5, Invoke(add, ('a',), {'y': ('b',)}))
print('Invoke:', result5)

# Coalesce
target6 = {'a': None}
result6 = glom(target6, Coalesce('a', 42))
print('Coalesce:', result6)

# Check
target7 = {'val': 'hello'}
result7 = glom(target7, Check(str))
print('Check:', result7)

print('\nAll tests passed!')
"
